offering_description.value: Independent insurance agency that sells personal, commercial, life and employee benefits coverage to individuals and businesses, earning commissions from insurance carriers through its agency offices.

primary_services.value: insurance brokerage; retail insurance agency; employee benefits consulting; risk management advice
